purpose: Address the failed P10 combined stratum gate without changing or reclassifying that failure
previous_confirmation: 1201-1203 is consumed diagnostic data; combined remains unqualified

changes.structure: retain depth12/width4 search but require positive means and nonnegative minima in both five-scenario selection and eight-scenario audit
changes.posterior: at least eight uncensored distinct first responses and a dominant aligned/inverse posterior >=0.99
changes.public_covariate_guard: disable persona adaptation when absolute Pearson correlation between observed first responses and initial public degrees is >=0.8; do not infer initial degree from altered topology
changes.contrast_guard: require at least two samples in each of one persona pair, with observed mean r separation >=0.15 in the dominant model's predicted direction; a globally high/low response alone is insufficient
changes.fallback: original P9 behavior whenever any new adaptation guard is closed; preserve explicit LLM approval and per-step legality for structure prefixes

rationale: 0.99 is a conventional stronger posterior evidence threshold; the public degree guard addresses observed confounding and the contrast guard requires the type difference actually used for prediction. These do not encode case IDs or tune on future results.

development.cases: the consumed 48 cases 1201-1203, paired with original P9; full replay, not only selected failures
development.promotion_to_new_confirmation: positive mean, each of four stratum means nonnegative, zero action/planning/resource failures

new_confirmation.population: same four fully resampled topology families and four response strata as P10, using new P10 random streams from distinct repetition IDs
new_confirmation.unlock: only after development completes and guarded source is frozen
new_confirmation.gate: same as original P10: mean vs P9 positive, family-block bootstrap 95% lower >0, every stratum mean nonnegative, at least two family means positive, complete public-action/identity/resource audits and real entry validation
